reader_summary.headline: Todd Simkin is an Associate Director at Susquehanna International Group.
reader_summary.overview: Todd Simkin is an Associate Director at Susquehanna International Group. Todd is also the CEO of Susquehanna Re, his latest role in a 27-year tenure at SIG that has spanned trading, strategic initiatives, and trader education. Our conversation covers the history of SIG alongside Todd's roles, trader development, the art and science of trading, risk management, recruiting talent, competitive advantages, luck.
